== (8) THINGS CHECKED THAT ARE FINE (so the next auditor does not redo them) ==

- REC-GOAL-3's non-goals match seed §9/§10 (no new dashboard, no supervisor changes, no model-perf
  restructure, no sprint-protocol change).
- REC-LIFE-4 correctly places never-idle as a FLEET property discharged by the standing ladder, and
  refuses to keep a model alive after residue exhaustion — this is the right reading of §7c.22 and
  avoids the obvious misreading ("never idle" -> keep the reconciler running).
- REC-LIFE-7 carries the overnight semantics from §7/§7.4 (wall, stop-after-N-closes, gauge stop,
  reduced parallelization, mandatory heartbeats) and adds the per-wake wall on top; a wake that
  outlives its wall is killed and reported. Consistent.
- REC-VERB-5 preserves ruling 21's red-first clause verbatim in substance ("valid only if the gate
  was seen red first") — this is the clause most likely to be lost in a fold, and it survived.
- REC-ESC-4 preserves ruling 20's anti-protocol-skipping clause ("a concern is input ... never a
  discharge; an agent that asserts a concern still meets or fails its own acceptance gate").
- REC-CTRL-4 preserves ruling 25's "tested only by actually hitting limits — never by burning
  tokens purely to test", and correctly refuses to let a lane handle its own exhaustion.
- REC-GATE-1 keeps F5's probe/decision channel separation and excludes probes from BOTH numerator
  and denominator (the stronger, correct choice).
- §7's "Deferred to design" list is honest about what it does not decide (pre-pass implementation,
  attestation plumbing, run-record schema) — finding 10b is only that the schema's mandated field
  list omits the AUTOPILOT-5H terms, not that deferring the schema is wrong.
- The "Citation pins" paragraph promises file:line pins against 14d8d6b; the document contains no
  file:line citations at all, so the promise is vacuous rather than violated. Not raised.
- decision-log §4's "offered, not ruled" items 1 (state the 19.4 %), 3 (two data tables are
  prerequisites), 4 (holds= at mint) and 5 (inbound rule + retraction path) are all discharged by
  the spec. Only item 2 is not — that is finding 12's second half.
